program.section_heading: Broadcasting: Streaming and Television associate degree (Program Code 060420, State Code 08535)
outcomes: Students will write broadcast copy for audio and video, including news, sports, entertainment, promos, commercials, and public service announcements with emphasis on video production.
Students will identify and apply theory and practice to create radio, podcasting, and television programs with emphasis on video production.
Students will demonstrate producing, programming, and hosting skills within a studio, radio station, or television station structure with emphasis on video production.

notes: The degree section's heading is not in the extracted text (page 56 begins with the program/state codes); the description calls it the 'Broadcasting: Streaming and Television associate degree', while the requested program title is 'Broadcasting: Television'. State Code 08535 distinguishes it from the Streaming and Television certificate (21889). Reviewer should confirm the heading and that this is the A.A.

Catalog course codes use leading zeros (BRDCSTG 001 etc.); matched to closed-list codes BRDCSTG 1, 3, 5, 21, 23, 25, 26, 28, 46, 47. Several catalog course titles differ from the state file titles (e.g., BRDCSTG 023 'Live Streaming Production' vs. 'News, Sports, and Live Remote Broadcasting'), apparently renamed.
'Major Units: 32' recorded as total_units; 'Total Minimum Units: 60' recorded as degree_total. The ten listed courses sum to 32. No GE pattern or GE units are named on the page.

Other sections on these pages (Performance, Podcasting and Radio, Streaming and Television certificates) were not used; the Streaming and Television certificate prints the same outcomes as the degree.
